messages:
maria: Quick heads up — after the KV-sampler rollout on canary, host-side parse tail latency spiked ~25ms for long-lived streams. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/r/host-parse :eyes:
kevin: Can you paste the pprof/stacktrace or a short repro?
maria: Repro is a curl loop hitting streaming endpoint with 8k token prefixes. I ran a cpu profile for 30s. Flamegraph link: https://prof.redwood.local/flame/6112233999
maria: pprof command I used:
```
go tool pprof -http=:8080 http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=30
```
kevin: Thx. I see the hotspot at ingress.parseChunk -> sampler.shouldSample -> kvcache.lookup (lots of small allocations). Looks like sampler probes are serializing where they could be async.
anya: Observed increased grpc smallwrites and more syscalls in the same time window. Might be sampler doing sync KV probes on request path. Suggest gating sampler behind async token to avoid blocking parse.
tim: Is batcher heuristic interacting? If sampler delays parse, batching windows grow and kernel selector picks wider seqlen buckets — could cascade to decode latency.
maria: Yeah — trace shows batching window widen ~1.2x under sampler load. Kernel selector then switches to mid-batch kernels at ~128->256 boundary.
kevin: Quick mitigation: disable sampler on canary and roll forward. I pushed a hotfix flag: `INGRESS_SAMPLER_MODE=off` to canary cluster. Applied at 11:12 PT.
ci-bot: Canary deploy started for service=host-ingress, deploy_id=deploy-20261122-08 :spinner:
anya: If we disable sampler, do we lose important telemetry? We could instead make sampler fire-and-forget: enqueue a probe to sidecar instead of inline KV lookup.
maria: Agreed. Small proto for async enqueue below:
```
// enqueueSamplerProbe(reqID, key) -> returns immediately
go func() { sampler.enqueue(reqID, key) }()
```
kevin: I can spin a PR to convert `shouldSample` to `tryEnqueueSample` and fall back to `false` on full queue. That keeps p99 bounded.
tim: Also open question: kernel selection thresholds should factor in parse jitter. Maybe add `ingress_parse_jitter_ms` metric into kernel chooser heuristic.
maria: Filed issue: https://git.redwood.local/infra/issue/4589 — PR drafted in branch `sampler-async-4589`.
kevin: Local microbench after async change shows tail drop back to baseline (p99 -27ms). Will run longer soak tomorrow. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks — leaving flag off on canary for now. Will call out in eng-runtime stand. :wave:
